Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Here are the main options we offer, in simple terms:
Shopping & ordering: Add items to your cart, choose delivery, then pay online at checkout.
Payment: Pay in USD with MasterCard, Amex, Visa, or PayPal.
Gift cards: Buy boutique gift cards for any value you choose.
Changing orders: Once placed, you generally need to wait for delivery and then use our returns process if you change your mind.
Returns: For online orders, you usually have 14 days from purchase to return through our online Returns Portal (or in any CAMILLA Boutique for in‑store purchases, also within 14 days).
Delivery: Standard and Express arrive Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm; someone must sign, or the parcel goes to a collection point and redelivery fees may apply.
Styling help: Book in‑person or virtual styling sessions with our boutique or online Angels.
Email preferences: Use “Manage My Preferences” at the bottom of our emails to choose which types of emails you receive.
Extra ordering help: Our Angels in boutiques can place orders for you, and our customer care team can also help place an order via live chat, phone, or email.
